label: Large bore stock pipes
description: Two hollow large-bore pipes on timber sleepers with end chocks.

label: Pyramid pipe stack
description: Six hollow pipes in tangent three-two-one courses; bottom course held by sleeper chocks.

label: Fixed lifting gantry
description: Grounded baseplates, braced columns and I beam carry an offset hoist and open hook. Clear span is visual only; no navigation clearance is implied.

label: Travelling lifting gantry
description: Wheeled braced chassis carries I beam, shifted trolley, cables and hook. Static display only.

label: Single tyre fender
description: Open rubber tyre suspended from a grounded wall-side steel stand; mounting side +Z, working face -Z.

label: Twin tyre fender
description: Two open rubber tyres with individual hangers and grounded supports; mounting side +Z.

label: Straight quay rail
description: Three baseplated posts with two continuous rails and a toe plate.

label: Return quay rail
description: Right angle return with supported posts, two rails and toe plates; return extends +Z.

label: Quay access ladder
description: Grounded feet, rungs and three wall stand-offs per stile; mounting wall is at +Z.

label: Guarded access ladder
description: Wall ladder with three connected half hoops and vertical cage straps projecting -Z.

label: Laid mooring coil
description: Two supported courses of rope rings with a short free tail; no tension or mooring simulation.

label: Twin bitt mooring rope
description: Grounded twin bitts with horns and three rope turns joined across both posts.

label: Open rowing boat
description: Open tapered hull, gunwales, three supported benches, stowed oars and rowlocks. Gallery bottom datum y=0; later water placement must choose immersion depth explicitly.

label: Outboard utility boat
description: Open tapered hull, two supported benches and transom-mounted motor with tiller, leg and propeller. Gallery bottom datum y=0; later water placement must choose immersion depth explicitly.

label: Flat deck lighter
description: Broad blunt hull, flush timber cargo deck and four supported mooring cleats; unpowered lighter. Gallery bottom datum y=0; later water placement must choose immersion depth explicitly.

label: Open hold lighter
description: Broad blunt hull, open ribbed floor, raised hatch coaming and four supported cleats; unpowered lighter. Gallery bottom datum y=0; later water placement must choose immersion depth explicitly.

label: Post-mounted lifebuoy
description: Open rescue ring with four pale bands and perimeter grab rope, hung from a grounded post.

label: Open rescue station
description: Open-front supported cabinet contains rescue ring, bands and perimeter grab rope.
